# Exposed gas topology software controls

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0

These three small topologies contain a synthetic four-carbon host and its
CO2/O2 parameter additions. They provide no molecular or biological evidence.
The host includes unused bond and dihedral parameter slots, with zero inactive
1–4 scales, to challenge preservation of complete source tables.

They were generated by [`gas_topology_control.py`](../gas_topology_control.py)
with the separately selected ParmEd 4.3.1 environment. The gas parameter
sources and license are described in the [parameter fixture index](../amber-templates/README.md).
The raw-table tests require no ParmEd installation or force evaluation.

The `split-host-type` controls use the same four-carbon host, with one atom
named as a different chemical type while sharing its original Lennard-Jones
index. ParmEd separates those indices during combination. Every resulting
host interaction must retain the original coefficient, including cross
interactions between the separated types. Generate these controls with the
additional argument `split-host-type`.
